name: Evals Platform
description: Dashboard and API for running model evals. Deprecated June 3, 2026; goes read-only October 31, 2026, and shuts down November 30, 2026.

name: ChatGPT Pulse
description: Proactive daily briefings in ChatGPT Pro that researched overnight and surfaced personalized update cards. Launched in September 2025; OpenAI is sunsetting it and pointing users to scheduled tasks instead.

name: ChatGPT Plugins
description: Third-party tool integrations for ChatGPT. The beta was wound down in favor of GPTs and Actions, then fully shut down April 9, 2024.

name: Videos API (Sora 2)
description: Programmatic access to the Sora 2 video models. Deprecated March 24, 2026; full shutdown scheduled for September 24, 2026.

name: Operator
description: Research-preview browsing agent at operator.chatgpt.com. Folded into ChatGPT Agent in July 2025, and the standalone site was sunset weeks later.

name: Canvas
description: Side-by-side writing and coding workspace inside ChatGPT.

name: Sky Voice
description: A ChatGPT voice shown at the GPT-4o demo, paused within days after comparisons to Scarlett Johansson's Her voice sparked a public dispute.

name: Computer-Use Model
description: The CUA model behind Operator, exposed as a preview API. The preview snapshot is scheduled for shutdown on July 23, 2026.

name: Edits API (/v1/edits)
description: Endpoint for editing text given an instruction. Deprecated in 2023 and shut down January 4, 2024.

name: Agent Builder
description: OpenAI's visual agent-building product for developers. Deprecated on June 3, 2026, with shutdown scheduled for November 30, 2026. ChatKit remains available. Recommended replacement: Agents SDK or ChatGPT Workspace Agents.

name: AI Fine-Tuning
description: Custom model training services for developers. Winding down as OpenAI shifts focus toward 'reasoning' models and RAG-based architectures, significantly impacting the strategy for AI startups. Recommended replacement: Anyscale or Together AI.

name: Sora (App & API)
description: A high-fidelity text-to-video platform. Abruptly shuttered following the collapse of a $1B Disney partnership and a strategic pivot to robotics/IPO prep. Recommended replacement: Google Veo or Kling.

name: GPT-3.5 Turbo (ChatGPT)
description: The model that brought AI to the masses. It was the default free-tier engine for over two years before being fully replaced by 'mini' architecture models to save on compute. Recommended replacement: gpt-4.1-mini or gpt-5.4-mini.

name: GPT-4.1 (ChatGPT Version)
description: The 'efficient' flagship that famously replaced GPT-4.5. While loved by developers for its logic, it was sunset in the ChatGPT interface less than a year later to force migration to the GPT-5 ecosystem. Recommended replacement: GPT-5.4.

name: GPT-4 Early Snapshots (0314, 1106, 0125)
description: Legacy GPT-4 and GPT-4 Turbo preview snapshots (including 0314, 1106-preview, and 0125-preview). Retired to streamline the API toward the GPT-5 series. Recommended replacement: gpt-5 or gpt-4.1.

name: GPT-5.1 (Instant, Thinking, Pro)
description: Short-lived iterative models from the GPT-5 series, retired across ChatGPT and GPTs to consolidate on the 5.2 architecture. Recommended replacement: GPT-5.2 series.

name: GPT-5 (Instant & Thinking Preview)
description: The initial launch versions of the GPT-5 series, sunset after the 5.1 and 5.2 updates rendered them obsolete. Recommended replacement: GPT-5.2.

name: GPT-4o (ChatGPT version)
description: The 'Omni' model that powered ChatGPT. Deprecated to consolidate users onto the GPT-5 foundational series. Recommended replacement: GPT-5 series.

name: chatgpt-4o-latest (API)
description: The specific dynamic pointer for the latest ChatGPT-flavor of GPT-4o in the API. Recommended replacement: gpt-5.1-chat-latest.

name: o4-mini
description: An efficiency-focused reasoning model. Retired from ChatGPT just four months after release. Recommended replacement: gpt-5.4-mini.

name: GPT-3.5 Legacy Snapshots
description: The final decommission of the GPT-3.5 architecture, including 1106 and turbo-instruct. Recommended replacement: gpt-5.4-mini.

name: Assistants API
description: A high-level API for building AI assistants. Deprecated in favor of the more flexible Responses and Conversations APIs. Recommended replacement: Responses API and Conversations API.

name: DALL·E 3
description: The third iteration of OpenAI's image generator. Retired to make way for the 'GPT Image' natively multimodal series. Recommended replacement: gpt-image-1 or gpt-image-1-mini.

name: DALL·E 2 (API)
description: The model that sparked the AI image generation trend. Retired alongside DALL-E 3. Recommended replacement: gpt-image-1-mini.

name: DALL·E 2 (Labs Web App)
description: The original web interface for DALL·E 2. OpenAI stopped accepting new customers and credit purchases on this date, directing all web users to DALL·E 3 within ChatGPT. Recommended replacement: ChatGPT (DALL·E 3).

name: gpt-4o-realtime-preview
description: The preview version of the low-latency audio API. Recommended replacement: gpt-realtime-1.5.

name: o1-preview / o1-mini
description: The first reasoning models from OpenAI. Sunset following the release of o3 and o4 series. Recommended replacement: o3 or o4-mini.

name: GPT-4.5-preview
description: A very short-lived preview that bridged the gap between GPT-4 and GPT-5. Recommended replacement: gpt-4.1.

name: Codex API
description: The specialized model series (including code-davinci-002) for natural language to code. Shut down with only 3 days' notice. Recommended replacement: gpt-4o.

name: Base GPT Models (Babbage-002, Davinci-002)
description: The remaining second-generation base models used for fine-tuning and simple completions. Recommended replacement: gpt-5.4-mini or gpt-5-mini.

name: OpenAI Gym
description: The industry-standard toolkit for reinforcement learning. OpenAI ceased maintenance in 2021. Recommended replacement: Gymnasium.
